attributes.action: Require all schools to teach ADHD & neurodiversity education
attributes.additional_details: Through my lived experience, campaigns and the free education initiative I provide whilst touring schools with, I have seen the importance of the Government introducing mandatory, age-appropriate education on ADHD and neurodiversity in schools to reduce stigma and improving understanding and inclusion.
attributes.background: We want the Government to require schools to provide age-appropriate education in every school about ADHD and neurodiversity, to help reduce stigma, improve inclusion and ensure all children, staff and parents are educated about these conditions.
